summary: Iteration 4 — Full backend + frontend validation of Phase 2 Knowledge Hub (TipTap rich editor) and regression of Phase 1 Work Requirements / Resumes / Vendors / Excel exports. Backend: 54/54 pytest tests pass (test_phase2_knowledge.py + backend_test.py) covering knowledge declaration validation, empty-content validation, submit -> pending -> admin publish -> public list/detail (by slug and by BNB id), admin CRUD, meta.knowledge_tags, WR submit with 10-digit mobile / valid email / invalid contact (422), WR pending-not-public + admin-approve -> public listing & detail, Resume/Vendor private-only (no public GET; 401 without admin token), and all 6 Excel exports (jobs, tenders, work-requirements, knowledge, resumes, vendors) return xlsx. Also confirmed admin/export requires auth (401). Frontend (Playwright against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL): /knowledge-hub loads with hero, knowledge-search-input and knowledge-filter-tag; /submit/knowledge shows the TipTap editor (knowledge-editor + knowledge-editor-area) with working toolbar (knowledge-editor-bold, knowledge-editor-table, link). Submitting WITHOUT ticking knowledge-declaration DOES NOT submit and shows the exact error toast 'Please confirm the declaration before submitting'; ticking it and re-submitting yields knowledge-success 'Thank you.' page. Admin login with Hitchhiker@360 works, admin-tab-knowledge is present, submitted article visible in Knowledge tab, admin-publish button works, and export downloads bnb-knowledge.xlsx. Admin-tab jobs/tenders/resumes/vendors also expose admin-export-button. Homepage view-all-wr strip conditionally renders — when >=1 active WR exists it becomes visible with WorkRequirementCard(s); when 0 active WRs the section is intentionally hidden (correct per Home.jsx guard). JobDetail apply-now conditional works — of 6 job detail pages tested, 5 had job-apply-now (with applicant_url) and 1 correctly omitted the button (no dead apply). KH detail page (/knowledge-hub/:slug) renders title, tags, Verified Source badge, posted date, BNB id and rich HTML including <table>. Admin Knowledge Create dialog opens KnowledgeEditor (kadmin-editor + kadmin-save-button) and saves an article that then appears in public /knowledge-hub. Two blocking issues observed: (1) Admin Work Req. tab uses data-testid=admin-tab-work-req NOT admin-tab-work-requirements as the review-request implied — tests should reference the actual id (this is a documentation/testid-naming inconsistency, not a functional bug), (2) Knowledge admin tab does not expose a status filter (filter-status testid absent) — the review-request suggested 'Set status filter to pending' but the UI shows all statuses in the same list (pending rows visible via presence of admin-publish button). Also observed carry-over a11y warnings (Radix DialogContent missing Description / aria-describedby) from iteration 3 — non-functional.

issues: No visible status filter (filter-status) — cannot narrow to 'pending' as spec suggests. All rows shown together; only the presence of publish button indicates pending state. Recommend adding the same status Select used on Jobs/Tenders/WR tabs.
Console shows Radix warnings 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent' — carry-over from iteration 3, non-functional a11y.

action_items: Naming consistency: review-request references data-testid 'admin-tab-work-requirements' but the tab is rendered as 'admin-tab-work-req'. Either rename the testid or update docs. All other admin tab testids match spec.
Add a status filter (e.g. data-testid filter-status) to the Admin Knowledge tab so pending vs active can be narrowed, mirroring Jobs/Tenders/WR tabs.

Optional a11y fix (carry-over from iter-3): add VisuallyHidden DialogTitle + DialogDescription to Radix DialogContent instances (KnowledgeEditor dialog, submitter/edit dialogs) to remove console warnings.

TipTap Ctrl+A does not select editor content programmatically in some browsers; not a bug but tests that need bold styling should use the toolbar toggle AFTER a document.selectAll via editor.commands, not the OS Ctrl+A. No product action needed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py knowledge slug construction concatenates slugify(title) with '-<bnb_id.lower()>'. If two articles get the same title, slugs are still unique due to bnb suffix — good. But GET /api/knowledge/{slug} does a case-sensitive slug lookup then a fallback bnb_id lookup with slug.upper(); the fallback works but note that slug is stored lower-case only. Fine.

KnowledgeSubmit.jsx strips ALL HTML tags to compute plain-text length before submit — a table with cells still trims to whitespace and can fail the 'add some content' check (verified: my Playwright content submission passed only because I typed real text). Consider using editor.getText() from TipTap for a more accurate check.
server.py list_knowledge uses re.escape(search) — good, guards regex injection. But no pagination beyond limit=100. Acceptable for MVP.
Resume / Vendor endpoints correctly have no public GET listing route (verified 404/405). Admin listing returns 401 without token. Data privacy rule satisfied.
EXPORT_COLUMNS['knowledge'] omits 'content' and 'declaration' — intentional (content is HTML). Consider adding column 'has_declaration'.
Home.jsx `workReqs.length > 0` guard means the strip is silently invisible if the /work-requirements endpoint errors or is empty — good UX, but no error state is shown. Acceptable.
JobDetail conditional {job.applicant_url && ...} correctly hides Apply Now when null — verified across 6 jobs.

All TEST_-prefixed knowledge, WR, resume and vendor rows were deleted post-run. Existing 'Test Article' (BNB-K-2026-00001) is unrelated and left untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Phase-2 KH endpoints & flows and Phase-1 regressions verified. Reusable test files: /app/backend/tests/test_phase2_knowledge.py (Knowledge Hub + WR + Resume/Vendor + Exports) and /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (admin auth, meta, jobs/tenders, sitemap, upload). Run: `pytest /app/backend/tests -n 0 --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. Admin testids: admin-tab-jobs, admin-tab-tenders, admin-tab-work-req (NOT ...-work-requirements), admin-tab-knowledge, admin-tab-inbox, admin-tab-resumes, admin-tab-vendors, admin-create-button, admin-export-button, admin-publish-<bnb_id>, admin-pending-badge. Knowledge: knowledge-editor / -area / -bold / -table / -link / -image, knowledge-field-title/summary/tags/source/author/authorinfo, knowledge-declaration, knowledge-submit-button, knowledge-success, kadmin-editor / -area / -save-button. Public: knowledge-search-input, knowledge-filter-tag, knowledge-search-button, view-all-wr, view-all-jobs, view-all-tenders, job-apply-now (conditional). Home strip requires at least one status=active WR; DB currently has 0 published WRs after cleanup, so home strip will not render until a WR is approved.
rca of the issue: N/A — no product bugs found. Two documentation/spec mismatches noted: admin-tab-work-requirements (spec) vs admin-tab-work-req (impl); and 'status filter on Knowledge admin tab' (spec) which is not present in current UI. Neither blocks functionality.
